content.label: Been using this app for about two months now after consistently strength training for about 1.5 years. App really structures workouts well and challenges me. I have put on 4 lbs of muscle since using the app! Adapts the workouts well to push for strength gains. Easy to swap out exercises when needed. Love the plate calculator! Highly recommend!

Gravl has been a great workout tracking app for me. It’s easy to use, keeps my workouts organized, and helps me see my progress clearly with stats like duration, calories, volume, and records. I like that it syncs with Apple Health and makes tracking strength training simple. Great app for staying motivated and consistent!

I’ve been using gravl for close to two years now. It’s great for beginners or experienced lifters.  The flexibility to have generated workouts or to create your own split is very nice.  I highly recommend it to anyone!
Worth It.

title.label: Good app but could be better

content.label: I like Gravl and have been using for a couple of months now.  The workout generator is great but even with variety set I don’t get machines/equipment I want to use.  Yes, I go in and change exercises to accommodate this but it would be nice when you select TRX the once in a while an exercises comes up for it.  The “AI” is in beta testing and needs some work but it is nice to tell it what I want (very detailed due to beta) and it produces close to what I was looking for.  I highly recommend this to everyone especially the one starting out at the gym like me

I love this app because it allows me to go into the gym and not have any anxiety because I don’t know what I’m doing in there. I’m not walking around aimlessly trying to figure out what muscle group to hit on which day with this app I can pick the split I want. Adjust anything to my liking and get a really good workout in. I highly recommend this if you’re planning to work out consistently and want something to keep you on track.
Used it off and on for a while.  Apple watch support is poor.  Like it when it works but too many crashes, sound bugs, timer bugs, inconsistencies.

This app has been an absolute life changer for me. It’s straight forward with workouts without wanting to also track my food/calorie intake. Customizable for your gym which is super beneficial for someone who only has a squat rack and free weights Gravl allows you to select the exact equipment available to you and generates workouts using that equipment. As someone who took many years off this was super helpful to have workouts with instructions. Being able to track my progression on each exercise and easily see my previous weights/reps/sets allows me to better judge my next workout. Overall a very straight forward app for anyone looking to get back into the gym without all the extras bells and whistles of tracking your calories as well. I started with a free trial and ended up purchasing a year at a discount. I will gladly pay full price again for this app year after year as at 33 I look better than I did at 18. All thanks to Gravl.

Está bien para armar rutinas pero no es tan personalizada como esperaba, teniendo IA creí que sería más intuitiva y personalizada pero la veo bastante similar a la versión gratuita de Heavy, de hecho llevo poco tiempo con la versión paga y sigo usando la otras gratis porque aún no me engancha. Intentaré usarla por un mes para no perder la inversión del año que ya pagué.
Me gusta todo

title.label: Didn’t think I needed it till I tried it.

content.label: Started using the Gravl app almost 2 months ago and my workouts are night and day. I’ve been consistently in the gym for 3 years now and thought I had a good plan in place. Same routine same workouts that I researched online. Once I started using Gravl I noticed immediately that I was starting to train muscles that weren’t being focused on as much. Muscles started waking up all over my body due to not utilizing progressive overload which is why I chose this app. I wish I had more friends open to using the app cause I like the tracking feature which allows me to basically compete and push with other friends. I recommend it.
This is a very comfortable workout for a beginner
I’ve been using it for a few days and so far it kicks a**. Great variety and AI features for learning is fantastic. 10/10 recommend.
The app does ok, but the biggest and maybe fatal flaw is that it only allows for limited muscle groups to be excluded

I had gotten the Fitbod app first was not user-friendly, but also this app is way more user-friendly. There’s a few things that I wish they would do to improve it. One of those is make it where you can reset your week and start with day one. And I feel like the form check videos are pretty accurate.

I’ve been lifting for 10 years but I never tracked my progress and struggled with changing up my exercises. This app does it all and it constantly challenges me with new workouts and the gains have been noticeable. My only complaint is that there is limited equipment, please keep adding more.

GRAVL has made a tremendous difference in my training and my results. I’ve lifted for years, but this app helped me get more consistent and more productive in the gym… the structure, progression, and exercise selection are all on point. What I appreciate most is that it removes the guesswork, it tells me exactly what to do, keeps me progressing, and the workouts actually feel designed to build an athletic, balanced physique. I’ve made some of my best progress since using GRAVL, and my DEXA scans clearly reflect it. It has helped me improve my body and I absolutely love the app! Every app has minor issues and the GRAVL team has been very responsive and helpful! Did I say how much I love the app?! this is an easy 5 stars.

Complete trash. They don’t let you get a free trial like all other apps and like they advertise online and when I paid, the first work out it gave me is push ups and sit ups. Are you kidding me? Complete waste of money. I really want a refund.

Using it for a couple of months. Needs to fix the Watch connection, when i start on the phone doesn’t allow me to use on the Watch. 
Sometimes wants me to use irreal weights, when i enter mannually what i can lift doesnt seem to keep record for next time…
Just downloaded and paid the monthly subscription and the “start workout” button stop working. Going on 2 days now

This app is really good! The only issue i have is that the app itself keeps crashing. It doesn't load and stays on the load screen. It happens way too many times. I use this app regularly but when that happens it really gets annoying.

Been using for a month and a half, 4 workouts a week. Already have more progress than the entirety of last year. Developer is very active on Reddit, answers questions and changes based on user feedback.

this is my first workout app and it would be perfect and i would be giving it 5 stars because i like the interface, but for some reason only half the videos are loading the others are just blurred out and unable to be played. i double checked and its not a connection problem everything else on my phone works fine

update: it was an issue with their service provider and i moved my review up to 5 stars!

I’m writing this in the middle of a workout because it’s bothered me so much. When syncing from phone ↔️ watch, the app kinda loses its mind in a sense of “which one do I go back to?” I like tracking with my watch, but you have to do one or the other, not both it seems. 

Another issue I’ve had with this method is if I’m tracking on the watch, it “seems to” sync with the phone, but I’ve had whole workouts end and never show up again. Couldn’t get the workout back, and a new workout was formulated. Extremely frustrating. 

Otherwise I love the app. It’s like Fitbod on steroids.
Been going to the gym regularly for a while ,  couple years  . After using the app and having designed workouts , I’m seeing results must faster .
Got the yearly for $50. It’s missing a few exercises but I’ve been getting stronger using this app. Definitely worth a try!

First week using the app, I’ve tried many. Not gonna lie I really like the ai workout plans it created for me. No thinking just work! And being able to add and take out workouts is legit. But the best part, telling the AI what machines you have access to (home gym) and what muscle group you want to emphasize on. So far it’s legit. Best I’ve tried.
I guess you only get a couple free. I wish it was like it was advertised as a free work app

title.label: Great app for gaining fitness and strength

Apple Watch integration … Just a great app!
I love this app

title.label: A Fresh Take On A Workout Program

content.label:
I’ve been a long-time Fitbod user for several years, but recently decided to give Gravl a try—and honestly, I’m glad I did. What really sold me was the variety of splits and routines you can choose from, plus the ability to incorporate deload weeks right into the program.

It feels familiar enough that the transition from Fitbod was easy, but Gravl adds the features I’ve been wishing for. The structure, flexibility, and overall flow just fit where I’m at with my training now.

If you’re looking for something that keeps the best parts of Fitbod but gives you more control and smarter programming options, Gravl is absolutely worth the switch.
Can’t get any workout plans without a subscription

title.label: Major issues with latest build and watch synchronization

content.label: Been using this app for over a year and recently it’s been giving me way too many issues. When running the workout from the Apple Watch, it constantly loses connectivity to my iPhone which screws up my session being recorded properly. A few times the app completely crashed my watch and messed up the session. It’s been working great for a while but recent builds have been buggy. I don’t have any other crashes on my Apple Watch outside of when I run this app.

Really liking this app so far. Good workouts, I love the timer between sets and being able to track my progress. I plan to keep using it.
Love this app. Tried so many workout apps and this is the one!

I am loving this app!! Even better they just released their Strava integration! This is game changing for me! The UI is so cool. It literally makes me excited about going to the gym.
Nice big layout, easy to see without glasses and from the distance and great customer support
